registry_note: Starting URLs were opened on the url_checked_on date. This checks source identity and starting-page accessibility only, not date-range coverage or current event details. Refresh every source during research. A homepage starting URL requires calendar lookup; blocked or missing listings must be reported in run coverage.

sources.notes: Open each requested daily calendar at /event-calendar/YYYY-MM-DD/. Follow organizer links for confirmation.

sources.name: Silver Moon Brewing
sources.notes: Page loaded during setup but calendar entries were absent in extracted text. Report partial coverage if dynamic listings remain unreadable. Flag overlapping festival/concert claims; do not invent separate stages.

sources.name: Dogwood at the Pine Shed
sources.notes: Calendar lookup needed; homepage mentions DJs and events but exposes no calendar in extracted text. Use official linked channels when readable and report gaps.

sources.name: Volcanic Theatre Pub
sources.notes: Homepage contains show listings; follow direct show/ticket links. Distinguish doors and show times.

sources.name: Midtown Ballroom / Domino Room
sources.notes: Follow show listings and record the actual room. Exclude Midtown Ballroom in Charlotte and other similarly named venues.

sources.name: Tower Theatre
sources.notes: Homepage contains upcoming shows; follow individual event/series pages and check explicit cancellation notices.

sources.name: Craft Kitchen and Brewery
sources.notes: Read calendar images when necessary, verify the displayed month/year, and follow venue-linked ticket pages.

sources.name: Discovery Corner

sources.name: Hayden Homes Amphitheater
sources.notes: Filter exact dates/year; out-of-season upcoming listings may be for the following year. Follow authorized ticket links.
